description: Fetch a single policy by ID from the running OPA server. Returns the Rego source; the parsed AST is omitted unless asked for, since it is roughly forty times the size of the source it came from. Use `rego_parse_ast` on the source when an AST is what's wanted.

includeAst.description: Include OPA's parsed AST alongside the source. Off by default.

name: opa_get_policy
title: Get OPA policy by ID
